recordText: A late Old English contraction of *cyning*. It may come from *cynn* ("leader of the people") or from a related Germanic word for noble birth. The Century Dictionary calls the link to *kin* undetermined but hardly to be doubted.
gossipText: Has quoted the Century Dictionary at every reunion since it was published. Brings his own chair.
testimony: Hardly to be doubted. That's what the dictionary says. I had it framed. Ignore the part above it, where it says undetermined.
